key_finding: Bami Bastani (42-year semiconductor veteran, ex-GlobalFoundries SVP, ex-CEO ANADIGICS/Trident/Meru — three turnaround public-company CEOs) is the US-listing architect. He joined as Strategic Advisor in Aug 2023, was elevated to Sivers Inc US Executive Chairman + Sivers AB Chairman in Feb 2024. The CEO change (Anders Storm → Vickram Vathulya, US-educated semiconductor executive, in Aug 2024) followed within months. The PCAOB-aligned restatement (May 2026) and the board reshuffle clearing out co-founder Erik Fällström (June 2026 AGM) follow the same logic: prep the entity for Nasdaq New York. The current board IS the listing team.

ceo.title: President & CEO

education.mba: Berkeley Haas School of Business, University of California

career: Maxim Integrated — grew RF and wireless businesses
Maxim Semiconductors — revitalized 'largest and most profitable' standard products business

skin_in_game.commitment: Subscribe to up to 2,000,000 Sivers shares

skin_in_game.contrast_note: Vathulya's seven-figure personal commitment is the opposite of the zero-shares-held REVIC deployment pattern Unitika exhibited with Kashiwagi Hisami. Vathulya is investing in his own bet.

ceo.framing: Vathulya's appointment was the signal that Sivers had chosen US capital markets as its endgame. A Lehigh PhD / Berkeley MBA running a Stockholm-listed company is not staffed for European institutional comfort — it is staffed for Nasdaq investor day.

chairman.framing: Bastani has been a public-company turnaround CEO three times. He is on the Sivers board as the US capital markets architect — and as the most experienced operating executive in the room.

departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.name: Erik Fällström
departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.current_economic_interest: Controls ~11.8% of Sivers votes via DDM Debt + Fällström Family Office
departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.departure_context: Strategic. DDM has publicly flagged that it 'wants to drive the company towards a broader investment company' — a vision in direct tension with the operational-focus thesis of the US-listing prep. His departure clears the room for a Nasdaq pitch that needs to talk about Sivers as a focused operating company, not as a vehicle for an activist holding play.

departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.name: Tomas Duffy
departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.education: BSc, Kungliga tekniska högskolan (Royal Institute of Technology, KTH), 1976-1980
career: Director of Large Corporates + Head of Telecom, EKN Exportkreditnämnden (Swedish Export Credit Agency), Dec 2010 - April 2017
Sivers IMA / Sivers Semiconductors Chair (since 2018; now Vice Chairman pre-departure)
departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.framing: Duffy is the institutional memory. He joined the board in 2016, became chairman in 2018, and was at the table for the 2017 CST Global acquisition, the 2022 MixComm acquisition, and the Sivers IMA → Sivers Semiconductors rebrand. His pre-Sivers career — Swedish state export-credit telecom finance — anchored the European institutional credibility of the entity through the early growth-stage years. The transition to a US-listing-architect chairman (Bastani) made him surplus to the next phase rather than wrong for the previous one.

departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.name: Keith Halsey
departing_at_2026_06_15_agm.framing: Halsey served only ~13 months before this reshuffle (elected May 2024, departing June 2026). Public biographical detail remains thin in the sources reviewed at the snapshot date — flag as a genuine sourcing gap and not a basis for inference. The short tenure pattern is consistent with a transitional appointment between the pre-Bastani board and the US-listing-prep board, but the rationale for his rotation is not stated in the AGM materials.

continuing_directors.name: Todd Thomson
continuing_directors.title: Independent Director (since 2021)
continuing_directors.education: MBA Wharton; BA Economics Davidson College
career: Citigroup Global Wealth Management — CEO ($10B division, 2.5 years)
Currently: COO & CFO, Kairos Ventures (US VC firm)
Investment Committees: Dynasty, Davidson College, World Resources Institute
continuing_directors.significance: Thomson is the most credentialed US-capital-markets figure on the board — former Citi CFO, former CEO of Citi's $10B Global Wealth Management division. He joined Sivers in 2021, three years before Bastani arrived and four years before the PCAOB restatement. He is therefore not part of the US-listing wave of appointments; he is the figure who LIKELY OPENED THE DOOR to the US-listing thesis in the first place. The Bastani-Vathulya-Thomson combination is unusually heavy on US public-company experience for a Swedish small-cap and that concentration is deliberate.

continuing_directors.name: Karin Raj
continuing_directors.title: Independent, Non-executive Board Director; Chair, Investment Committee
continuing_directors.sivers_role: Chair of the Investment Committee — structural authority over capex decisions
continuing_directors.framing: Raj is the technical anchor of the board. As Nokia's CTO Europe she carries direct big-tech-company experience in the exact intersection of segments Sivers operates in (telecom + satcom + semiconductors + photonics). Her chair of the Investment Committee role is the closest thing on the Sivers board to a structural CTO function — independent technical review of capex and product roadmap decisions.

new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.name: Joakim Nideborn
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.background: Broad experience as CFO at listed technology companies
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.stated_focus: Primary oversight of the Board for customers, employees, and investors in the Nordic region
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.current_role: CFO and Deputy CEO, HMS Networks AB (Nasdaq Stockholm listed industrial communications)
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.framing: Nideborn is a SITTING listed-company CFO and Deputy CEO at HMS Networks — a Nasdaq Stockholm industrial communications company. He is not a 'broad CFO background' in the abstract; he is a working CFO at a comparable Swedish listed tech company. The Vice Chairman role at Sivers gives him primary oversight of Nordic-region customers, employees, and investors — the governance counterpart to Bastani's US-capital-markets orientation.

new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.name: Helena Svancar
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.background: More than 20 years of international leadership experience
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.current_role: Partner, Verdane (Nordic growth-equity firm), since September 2022
career: Deutsche Bank — last 10 years; Managing Director and Head of Corporate Finance Nordics
Ericsson — Head of M&A for nearly 5 years
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.education: CEMS MSc in Finance and International Management — Stockholm School of Economics + University of St. Gallen
concurrent_boards: Truecaller — Non-Executive Director; Chair of Remuneration Committee
new_nominees_2026_06_15_agm.framing: Svancar is the most cross-border M&A-pedigreed director on the Sivers board. She was Head of M&A at Ericsson for nearly five years — running the M&A desk at one of Sweden's most acquisitive large-cap tech companies — and before that spent a decade at Deutsche Bank rising to Managing Director and Head of Corporate Finance Nordics. Her appointment to a board preparing a US dual listing is signal-dense: a former Deutsche Bank Head of Corporate Finance Nordics and former Ericsson M&A head is the addition a board makes when it expects to execute cross-border transactions.

post_agm_board_composition.framing: 5-person board (vs Unitika's 12-person director+auditor structure) reflects Swedish corporate governance norms. Smaller boards are typical for growth-stage Swedish-listed companies; smaller boards are also typical for companies preparing US listings where the SEC + NYSE/Nasdaq corporate governance rules emphasize majority-independent + audit-committee + governance-committee structures.

concurrent_governance_concerns.insider_trading_investigation: Sweden's Economic Crime Authority (Ekobrottsmyndigheten) is examining possible market abuse violations related to the Nasdaq listing announcement, which leaked roughly 48 hours early via an anonymous X account. The investigation is open as of the snapshot date and the outcome could materially affect investor sentiment heading into the AGM.
concurrent_governance_concerns.msci_inclusion_timing: Sivers joins MSCI Sweden Small Cap Index on 2026-05-29 — the same day Q1 results are released (delayed from earlier window) — forcing passive fund buying simultaneously with the first earnings under the new PCAOB regime.

board_composition_observation: The post-AGM board carries FOUR directors whose primary professional identity is corporate-finance and M&A execution: Bastani (3× public-company turnaround CEO), Thomson (ex-Citi CFO, current Kairos COO/CFO), Nideborn (sitting HMS Networks CFO + Deputy CEO), and Svancar (ex-Deutsche Bank Head of Corporate Finance Nordics + ex-Ericsson Head of M&A). For a Stockholm small-cap that is approximately $2.2B market cap, this concentration of corporate-finance pedigree is unusually heavy and points to a board built not just for organic growth but for transactional work — the planned US dual listing being the explicit case, acquisitions to scale up before listing being an obvious adjacency.
